DC_USBHID_DEVICE_FREE(3) Library Functions Manual DC_USBHID_DEVICE_FREE(3)

NAME

dc_usbhid_device_free — Destroy the USB HID device and free all resources.

LIBRARY

library “libdivecomputer”

SYNOPSIS

#include <libdivecomputer/usbhid.h>

void
dc_usbhid_device_free(dc_usbhid_device_t *device);

DESCRIPTION

Destroy the USB HID device and free all resources. The usbhid device usually found by searching through dc_usbhid_iterator_new(3).

SEE ALSO

dc_usbhid_iterator_new(3).
